question: Which of the following is an example of an infectious disease?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tuberculosis.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tuberculosis** is caused by a bacterium called **Mycobacterium tuberculosis,** belonging to the** Mycobacteriaceae family** consisting of about 200 members.
 
• Tuberculosis is a **communicable disease,** it spreads from one person to another through contact. 
 
• **Infectious diseases** are caused by pathogenic microorganisms, such as bacteria, viruses, worm or Protozoa, etc
 
 
• They can be spread directly or indirectly, from one person to another through body secretions, insects, or other means of transportation.
 
 
 
• Zoonotic diseases are also infectious when transmitted from animals to humans.
